blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — They say that weightlifting is all about strength and technique, but this young athlete added some style. Thirteen-year-old Prince Jhay Cuyson proved that a little flair can make a successful lift even more memorable after celebrating with a playful twerk, hair flip, and a sweet flying kiss at a youth weightlifting competition organized by Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz. Cuyson caught the eye of spectators and social media users after a video of his performance showed him pulling off a successful clean and jerk lift before breaking into an entertaining celebration.
